acceptanceCriteria: Equal divisions, ratios, cents and explicit-frequency degree definitions resolve deterministically with the approved 4096-degree per-object bound.

Reference adjustment semantics for relative and explicit definitions are documented and tested; invalid ratios, non-finite values, overflow, invalid counts and out-of-range resolution are handled deterministically.
Contextual metadata and user-defined variants preserve specific system/tradition, region, instrument or musical context and supplied provenance without claiming a universal tuning.
Integrated named/direct pitch, tuning degrees and written/sounding values preserve precision and identity; calculated results satisfy ±0.1 cent.
Independent expected-value fixtures and T-0007 regressions pass through package, iPhone and Watch test hosts; core remains platform-neutral.
notes: PLAN-002 approved for planning; activation and implementation require separate user authorization.
Detailed scope and cross-Epic acceptance boundaries: docs/Epics/EP-002-Planning.md.
Scope: Packages/JustTonesCore, necessary iPhone/Watch test hosts, architecture and evidence documentation. No audio, persistence, synchronization, catalog content, or authoring UI implementation.
Prerequisite: T-0007 implemented with passing evidence; SP-002 reviewed before SP-003 activation.
Epic criteria: JT-AC-007, JT-AC-008 and domain calculation contribution to JT-AC-010.
JT-TEST-009/011 provide domain cases. JT-TEST-010 catalog source review and JT-TEST-012 persistent UI lifecycle remain downstream.
rationale: Build generalized tuning on the core pitch engine and qualify their integrated domain behavior.
testSteps: Test all four representations, equivalent ratio/cents values, reference changes, counts at and beyond 4096, invalid and non-finite inputs, overflow and supported-frequency boundaries.
Test distinct contextual variants and repeated domain round trips; compare against independent expected-value fixtures.
Run beta-toolchain package and iPhone/Watch host tests, including T-0007 regressions; record actual commands, destinations and residual cross-Epic acceptance work.

workItem.title: Implement generalized tuning and qualify the integrated domain engine
